title: CAD IR Phase 1 — Foundation, Executor, First Repair Loop
summary: Implementation plan for Phase 1 of the CAD IR foundation: schema, evaluator, validator, build123d codegen, sandbox executor, and first repair loop integration.
notes: Implementation plan (task-by-task checklist) for Phase 1 of CAD IR work. Not an ADR (no Decision/Consequences structure, no Accepted status), not a PRD (no user stories or business requirements), not a SPEC (the spec it implements is referenced separately). Classified as DOC because it is a structured execution plan / runbook that supplies context rather than locked decisions or contracts.
